h: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala announces the death of her mother, Prof Kamene Okonjo, aged 96
p: WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala has announced that her mother, Professor Kamene Okonjo, has died at the age of 96. Tributes are expected from across Nigeria and beyond.
more: Prof Okonjo was a respected academic and a former traditional title holder in Delta State.
The family is expected to announce funeral arrangements.
